<style>

solid var(--gold);padding:14px;border-radius:6px}.guide b{font-size:13px}.guide p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:#b8cbd4;margin:7px 0 0}.brief .smallnote{font-size:11px;color:#7791a3}.phone-holder{width:390px;height:844px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative}.phone{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:390px;height:844px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:27px;border:1px #inspector{background:#111b2c;border:1px solid #293b50;border-radius:15px;padding:18px;min-height:280px}.statrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #26394b;font-size:12px}.statrow:last-child{border:0}.statrow span{color:#91a9b9}.statrow b{color:#e9f6ff;text-align:right}.inspector .hint{font-size:12px;color:#849fb0;line-height:1.75;margin:14px 0}.reset-all{padding:11px 18px;border:1px solid #496b7a;border-radius:10px;background:#17283b;color:#eaf4ff;width:100%}
#app{height:100%;width:100%;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#081327,#050c18 55%,#071324)}.screen{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}.backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% 51%,#0a2947aa,transparent 50%)}.scene-zoom{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 47%;transition:transform .3s var(--cyan);width:44px;height:44px;background:#1fc7b518;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 15px #2bcebe16,0 0 25px strong{font-size:18px;display:block;white-space:nowrap}.topcopy span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#91acc1}.topbar .round{width:47px;height:47px}.mission{top:101px;left:23px;right:23px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.statuschip{padding:10px #366577;border-radius:28px;color:var(--cyan);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.progress{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12px;min-width:121px}.track{width:70px;height:12px;background:#192a38;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.track svg{width:26px;height:26px}.actions{bottom:22px;left:21px;right:21px;display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:10px;height:80px}.square-action{width:66px;flex-shrink:0;background:#122b3e;border:1px solid .glyph{font-size:24px}.confirm{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#f9d9a4,#eab87b);color:#102435;font-weight:850;font-size:19px;box-shadow:0 7px 24px #0006}.confirm:disabled{background:#67798a;color:#253448}.overlay{position:absolute;z-index:10;inset:0;background:#020811aa;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}.sheet{width:100%;background:#101f33;border:1px solid #3e667d;border-radius:25px 25px 0 0;padding:15px 24px 25px;min-height:348px;box-shadow:0 -18px 60px #0006}.handle{height:5px;width:52px;background:#6d8ea7;border-radius:3px;margin:0 auto 20px}.sheethead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.sheet h2{margin:0;font-size:21px}.sheet p{color:#9cb6c7;font-size:11px;margin:7px 0 18px}.sheet .close{font-size:24px;color:#c0d7e6;background:#1b344a;border:0;border-radius:50%;width:39px;height:39px}.settingrow{background:#1a304a;border-radius:13px;padding:13px;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px}.settingrow strong{font-size:13px}.settingrow small{display:block;color:#94adbe;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px}.settingrow button{border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #4f7b88;background:#0c2636;color:#9fe8e0;padding:9px 10px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px}.colorchoices{display:flex;gap:5px}.colorchoices button{width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;padding:0;border:2px solid #c5d5db}.colorchoices .cyan{background:#53ded6}.colorchoices .violet{background:#9894f2}.colorchoices .contrast{background:#e5e8f1}.colorchoices button.chosen{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}.page{height:100%;overflow:auto;background:#07111f;padding:33px 22px #314f61;border-radius:50%;color:var(--txt);width:42px;height:42px;font-size:26px}.page-head h2{font-size:22px;margin:0}.page-head small{font-size:11px;color:#9db4c2}.card{border:1px solid #29485e;background:#112339;border-radius:17px;padding:17px;margin-bottom:14px}.card h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px}.card p{color:#9ab2c3;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}.card .muted{font-size:11px;color:#8fa6b7}.card .cyan{color:var(--cyan)}.action-link{background:#19334b;border:1px solid span{color:#abc0cb}.rank-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px}.rank-tabs button{flex:1;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:#13283b;border:1px solid #325064;color:#bad0db}.rank-tabs .sel{background:#23516a;color:#95f3eb}.rankcell{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:15px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #294459}.rankcell b{color:var(--gold)}.rankcell.mine{background:#21415a;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #4b8a8d}.toast{position:absolute;z-index:30;left:50%;bottom:118px;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:12px 15px;color:#eefff8;background:#183b47;border:1px solid #4faaa0;max-width:320px;width:max-content;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 12px 25px #0008;font-size:12px}.finished{text-align:center;padding:22px 0}.finished h3{color:var(--gold);font-size:22px}.finished button{background:var(--gold);color:#12283c;padding:12px 22px;border:0;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700}
@media (max-width:1150px){.workspace{gap:16px}.brief,.inspector{width:230px}}
@media (max-width:900px){.brief,.inspector{display:none}.workspace{padding:0;display:block;height:100svh;min-height:0}.phone-holder{margin:0 auto}.phone{border-radius:0;border:0;box-shadow:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

.archive-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.archive-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}

</style>
</head><body>
<div class="workspace">
 <aside class="brief">
  <div class="eyebrow">DESIGN × ENGINEERING / PROOF OF CONCEPT</div>
  <h1>NeuroTrace <span>V0.4</span></h1>
  <p>从已经评审的游戏画面，继续向可操作的前端原型推进。这里只使用<strong>示意神经纤维和模拟游戏状态</strong>，没有连接真实科研数据、服务器或用户账号。</p>
  <div class="process"><div class="step done"><span>01</span><div><b>需求与约束</b><small>全屏任务、辅助控件按需出现</small></div></div><div class="step done"><span>02</span><div><b>结构与视觉</b><small>沿用 V0.3 的审核结果</small></div></div><div class="step active"><span>03</span><div><b>可运行交互</b><small>选择、连接、撤回、跳过、设置</small></div></div><div class="step"><span>04</span><div><b>项目集成</b><small>等待开发团队的数据与接口</small></div></div></div>
  <div class="guide"><b>建议先这样测试</b><p>点击画面中央右侧的橙色端点 B → 点击「确认连接」→ 打开右下角「视图」→ 再检查右上角系统设置与档案。</p></div>
  <p class="smallnote">界面行为是可验证的模拟实现；选择策略、连接质量、数据存储与真实奖励机制仍需由项目代码定义。</p>
 </aside>
 <div class="phone-holder"><div class="phone" id="phone"><div id="app" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>
 <aside class="inspector"><div class="panelcap">交互状态 / STATE INSPECTOR</div><div id="inspector"></div><div class="hint">可在浏览器开发者工具中检查状态变化；亦可将本目录作为独立静态网站交给 Codex 运行。</div><button id="reset-all" class="reset-all">重置演示状态</button></aside>
</div>
<script>
/* NeuroTrace V0.4: UI-to-code functional proof of concept.
   IMPORTANT: SIMULATED GRAPH CONNECTIVITY. Not scientific validation, no persistence/API. */
const state = {page:'game',previous:'game',viewOpen:false,selectedA:true,selectedB:false,taskIndex:0,total:2,score:68,connections:[],palette:'cyan',mode:'fibers',zoom:1,sound:true,reducedMotion:false,toast:'',rankPeriod:'周榜'};
const $=sel=>document.querySelector(sel);
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
function icon(name){const paths={gear:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19 13a7 7 0 0 0 0-2l2-2-2-4-3 1-2-2H10L8 6 5 5 3 9l2 2v2l-2 2 2 4 3-1 2 2h4l2-2 3 1 2-4z"/>',back:'<path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/>',sliders:'<path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/><circle cx="9" cy="6" r="2" fill="#10293b"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="2" fill="#10293b"/><circle cx="7" cy="18" r="2" fill="#10293b"/>',archive:'<rect x="5" y="4" width="14" height="16" rx="1"/><path d="M8 9h8M8 13h8M8 17h6"/>',eye:'<path d="M2 12s4-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-4 7-10 7S2 12 2 12Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>',user:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21c0-9 16-9 16 0"/>',check:'<path d="M4 12l5 5L20 6"/>',info:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 11v6M12 7h.01"/>'};return `<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${paths[name]||paths.info}</svg>`}
function toast(msg){state.toast=msg;render();setTimeout(()=>{if(state.toast===msg){state.toast='';render();}},1900)}
function setPage(p){state.previous=state.page;state.page=p;state.viewOpen=false;render()}
function goBack(){if(state.page==='game'){setPage('lobby');return}if(state.page==='settings'){setPage('game');return}if(state.page==='profile'){setPage('settings');return}setPage('game')}
function currentTask(){return `A-${1048+state.taskIndex}`}
function gameHTML(){const completed=state.taskIndex>=state.total;const n=state.taskIndex;
return `<section class="screen" id="game-screen" aria-label="神经纤维连接游戏">
<div class="scene-zoom palette-${state.palette} ${state.mode==='points'?'points-only':''}" id="scene" style="transform:scale(${state.zoom})"><img class="scene-base" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="示意神经纤维拓扑结构，并非真实脑影像">
${!completed?`<svg class="current-connect ${state.connections.some(x=>x.status==='confirmed'&&x.index===n)?'connection-made':''}" viewBox="0 0 390 844" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M223 382 Q253 374 282 392" style="opacity:${state.selectedA&&state.selectedB?'1':'0'}"></path></svg><button id="nodeA" type="button" aria-label="选择节点 A" class="node-hit a ${state.selectedA?'selected':''}"></button><button id="nodeB" type="button" aria-label="选择节点 B" class="node-hit b ${state.selectedB?'selected':''}"></button>`:''}</div>
<div class="hud topbar"><button class="round ghost" data-page="lobby" aria-label="返回游戏大厅">${icon('back')}</button><div class="topcopy"><strong>神经拓扑连接</strong><span>TASK ${String(n+41).padStart(3,'0')} / ${currentTask()}</span></div><button class="round ghost" data-page="settings" aria-label="打开全局系统设置">${icon('gear')}</button></div>
<div class="hud mission"><span class="statuschip">连接任务 · ${completed?'已完成':'进行中'}</span><div class="progress"><div class="track"><span style="width:${100*Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)/state.total}%"></span></div><b>${Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)} / ${state.total}</b></div></div>
<div class="hud tophelp"><div class="instructions"><small>神经纤维 / 交互视窗</small>${completed?'本轮演示任务完成': '点选两端节点 · 补全连接'}</div><button class="archive-btn" data-page="archive">${icon('archive')} <span>回声档案</span></button></div>
${completed?`<div class="hud finished" style="top:345px"><h3>本轮任务已完成</h3><p>已记录 ${state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='confirmed').length} 次演示连接</p><button id="restart">开始新一轮</button></div>`: `<div class="hud goal"><small>当前目标 · ${currentTask()}</small><b>补全断裂的神经纤维</b><span>已选择节点 ${Number(state.selectedA)+Number(state.selectedB)} / 2</span></div><button class="view-trigger" id="open-view" aria-label="打开视图与观察工具">${icon('sliders')}<span>视图</span></button><div class="hud actions"><button id="undo" class="square-action" aria-label="撤回上一步"><span class="glyph">↶</span><span>撤回</span></button><button id="connect" class="confirm" ${!(state.selectedA&&state.selectedB)?'disabled':''}>确认连接</button><button id="skip" class="square-action"><span class="glyph">⏭</span><span>跳过</span></button></div>`}
${state.viewOpen?viewSheet():''}</section>`;}
function viewSheet(){return `<div class="overlay" id="viewoverlay"><div class="sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="视图与观察工具"><div class="handle"></div><div class="sheethead"><h2>视图与观察工具</h2><button class="close" id="close-view" aria-label="关闭视图工具">×</button></div><p>仅调整当前示意神经图像的显示，不改变连接记录</p><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>显示模式</strong><small>${state.mode==='fibers'?'纤维与节点':'突出连接节点'}</small></div><button id="toggle-mode">切换模式</button></div><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>配色与对比度</strong><small>为不同显示需求切换效果</small></div><div class="colorchoices"><button class="cyan ${state.palette==='cyan'?'chosen':''}" data-color="cyan" aria-label="青蓝方案"></button><button class="violet ${state.palette==='violet'?'chosen':''}" data-color="violet" aria-label="紫蓝方案"></button><button class="contrast ${state.palette==='contrast'?'chosen':''}" data-color="contrast" aria-label="高对比方案"></button></div></div><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>观察视角</strong><small>缩放 ${Math.round(state.zoom*100)}%</small></div><button id="zoom-view">${state.zoom>=1.3?'重置视角':'放大场景'}</button></div></div></div>`}
function head(t,subtitle){return `<div class="page-head"><button class="back" id="go-back" aria-label="返回">‹</button><div><h2>${t}</h2><small>${subtitle}</small></div></div>`}
function lobbyHTML(){return `<section class="page">${head('研究中心','众包神经连接任务 · 演示环境')}<div class="card"><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:13px">NEUROTRACE / RESEARCH CENTER</div><h3>继续连接神经纤维</h3><p>基于真实任务逻辑构想的界面演示。这里不含真实成像数据及科研审核。</p><button class="action-link" data-page="game">进入全屏连接任务 <span>→</span></button></div><button class="action-link" data-page="rank">群星排行榜 <span>›</span></button><button class="action-link" data-page="archive">回声档案 <span>›</span></button><button class="action-link" data-page="profile">个人中心 <span>›</span></button><button class="action-link" data-page="settings">全局系统设置 <span>›</span></button></section>`}
function settingsHTML(){return `<section class="page">${head('系统设置','应用行为、帮助与隐私入口')}<div class="card"><h3>游戏体验</h3><div class="listrow"><span>音效（本演示不播放音频）</span><button class="togglebtn" id="toggle-sound">${state.sound?'已开启':'已关闭'}</button></div><div class="listrow"><span>减少动态效果</span><button class="togglebtn" id="toggle-motion">${state.reducedMotion?'已开启':'已关闭'}</button></div></div><div class="card"><h3>账户与权限</h3><p>账户身份与数据管理独立于当前视图工具。</p><button class="action-link" data-page="profile">进入个人中心 <span>›</span></button><button class="action-link" id="help-info">玩法帮助（演示） <span>›</span></button></div><div class="card"><h3>关于本原型</h3><p>这是一个离线功能演示；不收集隐私信息、不访问设备权限、不发送任何神经连接结果。</p></div></section>`}
function archiveHTML(){const records=state.connections.slice().reverse();return `<section class="page">${head('回声档案','任务与研究记录 / 具体业务定义待确认')}<div class="card"><h3 class="cyan">档案入口已恢复</h3><p>当前采用临时结构：展示本次交互演示中的连接/跳过历史。正式「回声档案」可能有其他科学或叙事含义，不能以此替代真实产品需求。</p></div><div class="card"><h3>本次会话记录</h3>${records.length?records.map((r,i)=>`<div class="listrow"><span>${esc(r.id)}　${r.status==='confirmed'?'已连接':'已跳过'}</span><b>${r.status==='confirmed'?'+10':'—'}</b></div>`).join(''):'<p>暂无记录。进入游戏选择两个节点并确认后，这里会出现记录。</p>'}</div><button class="action-link" data-page="game">返回研究任务 <span>→</span></button></section>`}
function profileHTML(){return `<section class="page">${head('个人中心','玩家身份、贡献记录与账号资料')}<div class="card"><h3>◈　四七</h3><p>破壁人 / RESEARCHER</p><div class="listrow"><span>本次演示积分</span><strong class="cyan">${state.score}</strong></div><div class="listrow"><span>连接次数</span><strong>${state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='confirmed').length}</strong></div></div><button class="action-link" data-page="archive">我的研究记录 <span>›</span></button><div class="card"><h3>账号与隐私</h3><p>真实账号、邮箱、地址、权限与数据删除流程尚未开发。该页面仅验证功能模块归属。</p><button class="action-link" id="account-info">账号管理（待项目接入） <span>›</span></button></div></section>`}
function rankHTML(){const names=[['01','飞鸿踏雪泥',6675],['02','xufun',247],['03','HAPPY',163],['04','星之惑者',159],['05','18377865412',149],['06','wulele',98],['07','Dreamy',94],['08','玄鸟',87],['09','四七',state.score]];return `<section class="page">${head('群星排行榜','历史截图演示数据，非实时排行')}<div class="rank-tabs">${['周榜','月榜','总榜'].map(x=>`<button class="${state.rankPeriod===x?'sel':''}" data-period="${x}">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="card" style="margin-top:17px"><p>${state.rankPeriod} · 静态测试数据，个人积分随模拟任务变化</p>${names.map(x=>`<div class="rankcell ${x[1]==='四七'?'mine':''}"><span>${x[0]}　${x[1]}</span><b>${x[2]}</b></div>`).join('')}</div></section>`}
function render(){const pages={game:gameHTML,lobby:lobbyHTML,settings:settingsHTML,archive:archiveHTML,profile:profileHTML,rank:rankHTML};$('#app').innerHTML=pages[state.page]();if(state.toast)$('#app').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div role="status" class="toast">${esc(state.toast)}</div>`);const stats=[['当前页面',state.page],['演示任务',`${Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)} / ${state.total}`],['已选端点',`${Number(state.selectedA)+Number(state.selectedB)} / 2`],['提交连接',state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='confirmed').length],['跳过任务',state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='skipped').length],['本次积分',state.score],['视图模式',state.mode],['视图配色',state.palette]];$('#inspector').innerHTML=stats.map(([k,v])=>`<div class="statrow"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('');bind();fitPhone()}
function bind(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>setPage(b.dataset.page)));$('#go-back')?.addEventListener('click',goBack);$('#nodeA')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.selectedA=!state.selectedA;render()});$('#nodeB')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.selectedB=!state.selectedB;render()});$('#open-view')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.viewOpen=true;render()});$('#close-view')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.viewOpen=false;render()});$('#viewoverlay')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='viewoverlay'){state.viewOpen=false;render()}});$('#toggle-mode')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.mode=state.mode==='fibers'?'points':'fibers';render()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.palette=b.dataset.color;render()}));$('#zoom-view')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.zoom=state.zoom>=1.3?1:Math.round((state.zoom+.15)*100)/100;render()});$('#connect')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!(state.selectedA&&state.selectedB))return;state.connections.push({id:currentTask(),index:state.taskIndex,status:'confirmed'});state.score+=10;state.taskIndex++;state.selectedB=false;state.selectedA=true;toast('模拟连接已记录（未上传科研数据）')});$('#skip')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.connections.push({id:currentTask(),index:state.taskIndex,status:'skipped'});state.taskIndex++;state.selectedB=false;state.selectedA=true;toast('已跳过演示任务')});$('#undo')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.selectedB){state.selectedB=false;toast('已撤回节点 B 的选择');return}if(state.connections.length){const last=state.connections.pop();state.taskIndex=Math.max(0,state.taskIndex-1);if(last.status==='confirmed')state.score=Math.max(0,state.score-10);state.selectedB=false;toast('已撤回上一条演示记录');return}toast('当前没有可撤回的操作')});$('#restart')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.taskIndex=0;state.selectedA=true;state.selectedB=false;state.connections=[];state.score=68;toast('新一轮演示任务已重置')});$('#toggle-sound')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.sound=!state.sound;render()});$('#toggle-motion')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.reducedMotion=!state.reducedMotion;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('scroll-behavior',state.reducedMotion?'auto':'smooth');toast('演示偏好已更新')});$('#help-info')?.addEventListener('click',()=>toast('本版测试：选择端点 B，再点击确认连接'));$('#account-info')?.addEventListener('click',()=>toast('账号接口尚未接入；这里不会修改真实账户'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-period]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.rankPeriod=b.dataset.period;render()}))}
function fitPhone(){const h=$('.phone-holder'),p=$('.phone');if(!h||!p)return;const mobile=window.innerWidth<=900;const scale=mobile?Math.min(window.innerWidth/390,window.innerHeight/844):1;h.style.width=`${390*scale}px`;h.style.height=`${844*scale}px`;p.style.transform=`scale(${scale})`}
window.addEventListener('resize',fitPhone);
$('#reset-all').addEventListener('click',()=>{Object.assign(state,{page:'game',previous:'game',viewOpen:false,selectedA:true,selectedB:false,taskIndex:0,total:2,score:68,connections:[],palette:'cyan',mode:'fibers',zoom:1,sound:true,reducedMotion:false,toast:'',rankPeriod:'周榜'});render()});
window.neurotraceDemo={state,render,reset:()=>$('#reset-all').click()};
render();

</script></body></html>
